notes: Source read from the local copy /Users/ar/MyDocuments/projects/appproof/appproof_flutter (read-only). The app ships English (default locale in LocaleCubit) and Arabic; Arabic/RTL was drawn per the brief. Dark-only theme. Icons are the real Solar glyphs loaded from the local solar_community_icons font files; Latin text uses Inter (GoogleFonts.inter), Arabic falls back to the system Arabic font because Inter has no Arabic glyphs (same as on a device). Several things look slightly odd but are what the code does in Arabic and were kept: the hard-coded English 'min' in the task card ('18/30 min' shows as 'min 18/30'), the raw API status label 'Active'/'Completed' on the earnings cards, the raw plan value 'basic', the testers value '7 / 12' appearing as '12 / 7' under RTL bidi, the progress bar filling from the left (Alignment.centerLeft), and Solar arrow icons not being mirrored in RTL. The chart follows the code's own formula (dailyAvg * (0.5 + (i % 3) * 0.3)). The 1.2 letter-spacing of the 10px labels was not applied to Arabic text. App names (Mizan Budget, Rihla Trips), developer, amounts and dates are sample data. The home's 'Available apps' section exists in code but sits below the fold of this screenshot.
